entry.title: Starting a research notebook
entry.content:
I am starting this space to keep informal notes alongside my research on stochastic modelling of wireless networks. The plan is to write short pieces on things that are useful to me and might be useful to others:

  • Derivations and intuition — point-process identities, coverage and interference computations, and the small lemmas that never make it into a paper but take an afternoon to re-derive.
  • Simulation notes — how I set up experiments for non-terrestrial networks, what breaks, and reproducible snippets.
  • Paper walkthroughs — summaries of work I am reading, with the parts I found hard spelled out.

Posts will be irregular and deliberately rough. If something here is wrong or unclear, corrections are welcome.
entry.summary: Why this blog exists and what I plan to write about.
